name: P.C.B. Technologies Ltd
summary: P.C.B. Technologies Ltd provides printed circuit board (PCB) fabrication, assembly (PCBA), and advanced miniaturization solutions in Israel and internationally. It operates through Printed Circuit Boards, Electronics Outfit, and Miniaturization of Electronic Systems segments. The company is involved in the production, marketing, and sale of printed circuits and substrates; assembly of electronics components on printed circuits and electronic systems; and miniaturization of electronic systems.
